verdict.rationale: The README documents an in-agent marketplace install: `/plugin marketplace add Jakeschincariol/replica-skill` followed by `/plugin install replica-skill@replica-skill`. It also documents a manual alternative of copying the skill folders into `.claude/skills/` for a project-local setup. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that the skills are active in the next session, independent or hands-on confirmation that the install works, and a true single-command install (the marketplace flow takes two commands).
